title: UNRIVALED AHHHH #heatedrivalry #rachelreid #shanehollander #ilyarozan...
transcript: we have the first look at what I assume is the first draft of UnRivaled. classic Rachel Reid with the I hope you guys like Ilya and Shane. Don't worry, girl, you could write double, triple, quadruple that. I would read every single word. I am Jacob, and that is me right there. Literally spent 20 minutes just running around my apartment screaming. I love these books so much. I read them in 2022 right after the long game had come out, so I've never had to, like, wait for a new book cause I just read them all back to back to back to back. And yes, we still have a long wait ahead of us, unrivaled doesn't come out until June 1st, 2027, but I feel like it's going to be worth the wait. Definitely calling off work on June 1st I will be doing nothing but reading this book over and over and over and weeping. I just can't believe we're getting an actual book canon book where shane and ilya are married, where they play on the same team, where we get all of the centaurs. I am so excited. Thank you, Rachel. I just. I needed this today.
classificationReason: Content is entirely about an upcoming novel (UnRivaled by Rachel Reid, releasing June 2027). No connection to any live stage production.
